facts: No snow or storms in the forecast this week; highs near 54°F at pass elevation.

avalanche.travel_advice: Watch for signs of unstable snow such as recent avalanches, cracking in the snow, and audible collapsing. Avoid traveling on or under similar slopes.

facts.text: Snow left South Lake (9,600 ft) 38 days earlier this year than the median of the three earlier seasons on file (2023 to 2025).

evidence.name: South Lake
evidence.detail: left April 8; earlier seasons: June 27 (2023), May 16 (2024), May 11 (2025)

facts.text: At South Lake (9,600 ft), this year's highest snow water on or after April 1 was 2.4 in, the lowest of the four seasons on file (2023 to 2026).

evidence.name: South Lake
evidence.detail: 2.4 in on April 1; earlier seasons: 41.2 in (2023), 13.9 in (2024), 11.5 in (2025)

facts.text: An estimate: snow left the pass itself between April 10 and June 11, carried from the melt-out dates at South Lake (9,600 ft) and Sawmill (10,200 ft) to the pass elevation.

evidence.name: South Lake
evidence.detail: melted out April 8, 1,532 ft below the pass; points to April 2 to June 7

evidence.name: Sawmill
evidence.detail: melted out May 1, 932 ft below the pass; points to April 19 to June 15
